mapper.select: SELECT type FROM user_notification_settings WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND enabled = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_notification_settings (user_id, type, enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{enabled}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled)
INSERT IGNORE INTO notification_mutes (user_id, target_type, target_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId})
